_about: What each listing is an alternative to, only where the project's own README, GitHub description or website says so. n: the product it replaces. paid: true when that product costs money (it then shows on the 'Free alternatives to tools you pay for' shelf). src: where the claim is. quote: the project's own words. note: a caveat the project itself gives. Leave a listing out rather than guess.

voicestudio.quote: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative

photocraft.quote: an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Photoshop
photocraft.note: Its README says it is not yet a Photoshop replacement for daily professional work.

rustdesk.quote: An open-source remote desktop application designed for self-hosting, as an alternative to TeamViewer.

localsend.quote: An open-source cross-platform alternative to AirDrop

posting.quote: Posting is an HTTP client, not unlike Postman and Insomnia.

glances.quote: A top/htop alternative for GNU/Linux, BSD, macOS and Windows operating systems.

fd.quote: A simple, fast and user-friendly alternative to 'find'

duf.quote: Disk Usage/Free Utility - a better 'df' alternative
